excerpts.author: Sufyan S
excerpts.text: This place was amazing…the setup and vibe of the place is 10/10 so clean and maintained…

excerpts.author: JahanZeb B
excerpts.text: Its my goto spot every time I visit Pakistan…Highly recommended for anyone who loves authentic, soul-satisfying Pakistani breakfast. 5/5 stars.

excerpts.author: Jamal Z
excerpts.text: It was my first time visiting this chaaye khana restaurant, and I was genuinely impressed. The food was incredibly fresh and delicious…
